Capella House - A Beautifully Positioned Detached Dormer Bungalow in the Heart of Kildareâ€™s Racing Countryside.

Byrne Malone Estate Agents are delighted to present Capella House to the market, a wonderful four-bedroom detached dormer bungalow enjoying a beautiful setting in the heart of Kildare's renowned racing countryside. Nestled away from the hustle and bustle, yet within easy reach of the surrounding towns and amenities, this warm and welcoming family home offers generous and versatile living accommodation, beautifully maintained gardens and a host of additional features that make this a truly appealing home.

Approached via a spacious driveway with ample parking, the property immediately offers a sense of privacy and space. Internally, the accommodation is bright, comfortable and well laid out, with a combination of generous reception rooms, four bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a separate utility room, downstairs WC and the added benefit of a dedicated snooker/bar room, making it particularly well suited to family living and entertaining.

On entering the property, you are welcomed into a large and spacious entrance hallway, with beautiful floor tiling and plenty of natural light, setting the tone for the accommodation that follows. To the right is the impressive main sitting room, a bright and comfortable reception space featuring a stone-faced fireplace with a log-burning stove, creating a warm focal point and an ideal setting for relaxing on cosy evenings. To the left of the hallway is the family bathroom, beautifully presented and featuring a freestanding bath, providing a relaxing and comfortable space for the household. 

Continuing through the property, there are three bedrooms at this level. The accommodation includes a generous double bedroom with its own en-suite, timber flooring and freestanding wardrobe space, together with two further bright and airy bedrooms, also benefiting from timber flooring and freestanding wardrobes. To the rear of the property lies the heart of the home, with a generous open-plan kitchen and dining area providing an excellent space for everyday family life and entertaining. The kitchen offers good storage and workspace, while the adjoining dining area provides ample room for family meals and gatherings. Double doors open directly onto the patio and rear garden, creating a lovely connection between the indoor and outdoor living spaces. Also located on this level is a separate utility room and downstairs WC, adding to the practicality of the accommodation.

Moving upstairs, a spacious landing area is flooded with natural light and provides access to the remaining accommodation. To one side is a fantastic snooker room and bar, a particularly appealing addition to the home and an ideal space for entertaining, relaxing or enjoying family get-togethers.
To the opposite side is the impressive principal bedroom, a beautifully finished and generously proportioned room with carpeted flooring, a walk-in wardrobe and its own en-suite. This private upper-floor suite provides a peaceful retreat away from the main living accommodation.

Outside, Capella House is surrounded by beautifully maintained landscaped gardens, offering a wonderful level of privacy and an abundance of space for outdoor enjoyment. A spacious patio area provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining and entertaining, while the gardens themselves offer plenty of room for children to play and for the family to enjoy the surrounding countryside setting. The property also benefits from a separate outbuilding and garden shed, providing excellent additional storage and useful versatility for the new owners.

The location is undoubtedly one of Capella House's standout features. Set in the heart of Kildare's racing countryside, the property enjoys a peaceful rural setting while remaining within easy reach of a host of towns, schools and amenities. Naas, Newbridge and Kilcullen are all within easy driving distance, providing an excellent choice of shops, restaurants, schools, sporting facilities and everyday amenities.

Capella House offers a wonderful combination of space, privacy, versatility and location, making it an ideal choice for those looking for a substantial family home in a peaceful countryside setting, without being removed from the convenience of nearby towns. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the accommodation, gardens and superb setting this exceptional family home has to offer.
